name.ja: 30MM 1/144 bEXM-14T シエルノヴァ[ブラック]

description.ja: 30MMシリーズより、「シエルノヴァ」にカスタマイズの幅が広がるブラックが登場！
description.en: From the 30MM series, "Ciel Nova" is now available in black, which expands the range of customization!

description.ja: ■マッシヴな脚部、長い前腕、上方向に拡張できるバックパックなど、特徴的なパーツ構成。
description.en: • Distinctive parts configuration including massive legs, long forearms, and a backpack that can expand upwards.

description.ja: ■拡張可能な関節機構を採用。新規の股関節パーツを既存の機体に組み込み、体型のアレンジが可能。
description.en: • Adopts expandable joint mechanism. The new hip joint parts can be incorporated into the existing fuselage to rearrange the body shape.

description.ja: ■指揮官機用、特殊部隊用、近接格闘用オプションアーマーの胸部パーツはポルタノヴァと連動。
description.en: • The chest parts of optional armor for commander aircraft, special forces, and close combat are linked with Portanova.
